Test Scenario: Compare the messages for an unregistered email and a wrong password
Precondition: One registered account exists and one email address is known not to be registered
Test Steps: 1. Log in with an unregistered email and any password, and note the message 2. Log in with the registered email and a wrong password, and note the message 3. Compare the two messages
Test Data: unregistered email, then registered email with a wrong password
Expected Result: Both attempts return the same message, so an outsider cannot tell which emails have accounts
Actual Result: An unregistered email returns Please Enter valid Email ID, while a wrong password on a registered email returns Please Enter valid Password. The two messages differ, so the response reveals whether an account exists
Remarks: Derived from the results already recorded in TC_LOGIN_006 and TC_LOGIN_007. Logged as defect D-10.
